data.description:
## Incident Overview
**What**: Labels added after outbound bind don't sync in either direction. Outbound: local 'ticket tag <id> <label>' doesn't reach Jira. Inbound: Jira-side label add doesn't reach local store. Remove tests pass vacuously (no add ever propagated).
**Severity**: HIGH (data divergence on every label add after bind; affects every bound ticket).
**Impact**: Labels CRUD broken on bound tickets; bridges silently diverge.

## Reproduction
/tmp/labels-probe.sh — covers T1 outbound add (FAIL), T2 outbound remove (vacuous PASS), T3 inbound add (FAIL), T4 inbound remove (vacuous PASS). Used local 801e-fd0a-f20b-49db ↔ DIG-5011 today.

## Suspected Root Cause
1. INBOUND: _apply_inbound_update (applier.py:611-687) processes payload['fields'] only — never reads payload['labels'] which the inbound differ DOES populate (reconcile.py:740). Labels silently dropped on inbound. Build on bug 1bb2 fix (PR #450) pattern of using payload.get('local_id') for target dir.
2. OUTBOUND: outbound_differ may not emit a mutation when ONLY labels change (no scalar field diff). Need to verify whether label-only changes produce a mutation. If not, fix is to ensure label-only changes still emit an UPDATE mutation. If yes, the issue is in update_one's labels dispatch.

## Evidence
/tmp/labels-stderr-1780031000.log — RECON observability lines
